presets.extractTasksPrompt: Extract all actionable tasks from the following text. For each task indicate: clear title, brief description, priority (high/medium/low) and assignee if mentioned. Format: numbered list.
presets.executiveSummaryPrompt: Generate a professional executive summary of the following content. Include: main objective, key findings, decisions made, next steps and assignees. Max 300 words, executive tone.
presets.createSchedulePrompt: Create a detailed schedule based on the information provided. Include: phases, milestones, estimated dates, duration, dependencies and assignees. Markdown table format.
presets.smartPasteFormatPrompt: Convert the following text into structured tasks for SmartPaste. Extract: task title, description, priority (high/medium/low), suggested time block and duration in minutes. JSON array format.
